name: Heartbreak High
description: A fresh look at Hartley High over 20 years on. With her new friends - outsiders Quinni and Darren - Amerie must repair her reputation, while navigating love, sex, and heartbreak.

videos.title: Map B**ch
videos.overview: A hidden sex map rocks Hartley High as the students' sexcapades are publicly exposed. Caught as the culprit, Amerie becomes an instant social pariah.

videos.title: Renaissance Titties
videos.overview: Amerie, the new outcast, receives a party invitation that gives her butterflies. But when she manages to show up, a bitter surprise awaits.

videos.title: Eetsway
videos.overview: Still gutted by her friend's betrayal, Amerie finds comfort in a new boy, Malakai. A surprise visit sends Darren on an intimate adventure.

videos.title: Rack Off
videos.overview: A piece of locker room gossip tests Amerie's new romance. At the drug-fueled Mardi Gras Slay Ball, things escalate when Malakai faces off with a cop.

videos.title: Bin Chicken
videos.overview: As the students deal with the post-Mardi Gras fallout, Amerie learns she's double-crossed. A distraught Harper drops an incendiary speech on Dusty.

videos.title: Angeline
videos.overview: Quinni and Sasha begin to notice the cracks in their relationship. Meanwhile, Harper crashes a party to rescue her ex-friend from a sticky situation.

videos.title: The Sheriff
videos.overview: A rumor about Ms. Obah grows rampant on campus. To clear her name, Amerie stages a provocative protest and stumbles upon a shocking revelation.

videos.title: Three of Swords
videos.overview: Harper finally opens up to Amerie about her trauma whilst Darren faces a tearful confession. A street encounter suddenly takes a violent turn.

videos.title: Bird Psycho
videos.overview: It's the first day of the new term, but Amerie has already found herself at the center of drama. A PE teacher returns to campus with provocative ideas.

videos.title: SLTs vs C**LORDs
videos.overview: A hateful thread on the school message board leaves Amerie wondering who's behind it. The feud between two classes escalates into a football match.

videos.title: The Feelings Pit
videos.overview: While some newfound feelings continue to haunt Malakai, Hartley High's school captain candidates get competitive at a fundraising event.

videos.title: Legs Open Hearts Broken
videos.overview: As a new wave of notoriety follows Amerie on a camping trip, her efforts to track down a mysterious saboteur only make things worse.

videos.title: The Demon King
videos.overview: Amerie's group bands together to lift Quinni's spirits after a frightening incident. Missy uncovers a different side of Spider at his home.

videos.title: Just Kid $h*t
videos.overview: A video gains momentum for Amerie's school captain campaign. Darren grows worried when Ca$h doesn't show up to their housewarming party.

videos.title: The Grapes of Voss
videos.overview: For all three candidates, Hartley High's long-awaited school captain election turns out like nothing they ever expected.

videos.title: Boys Don't Cry
videos.overview: With a begrudged Timothy Voss returning to campus bearing a fiery message of revenge, Hartley's school formal descends into a whirlwind of chaos.

videos.title: Operation Headjob
videos.overview: As graduation looms, the Hartley High group dives into some hijinks with a rival school. A revenge plan takes a dangerous turn when someone gets hurt.

videos.title: Somebody Nose
videos.overview: At Uni Day, the group grapples with guilt from the previous night's events. Tensions rise as Harper uncovers a betrayal lurking within their circle.

videos.title: The Root Room
videos.overview: Amerie and Harper grow paranoid about a possible traitor in the group and set out to find them. Meanwhile, Missy's birthday party turns awkward.

videos.title: A Constitution for Cucking
videos.overview: The group attends a secret gig to celebrate being off the hook for the incident. Quinni faces bullying, while an unexpected kiss surprises everyone.

videos.title: A Good Egg
videos.overview: When damning evidence from the carnival emerges, Amerie's worries escalate. Emotions run high as confrontations erupt at the school showcase.

videos.title: Cuckoo, B****es!
videos.overview: New suspect, new plan. The Hartley crew seeks evidence but uncovers more secrets, causing distrust. Back at school, they face some troubling news.

videos.title: For Whom the Hartley Bell Tolls
videos.overview: Everyone involved in the prank navigates police scrutiny while graduation festivities begin. A decision is made - but is it the right one?

videos.title: Destined
videos.overview: The gang heads to Schoolies to celebrate their graduation, but a shocking revelation forces them to confront tough choices once again.
